# @stacklatte/chart-web (renamed)

> Deprecated name, fully supported. It re-exports `@stacklatte/chart-react` (the React / Next.js trading chart, `SLChart`) unchanged. New code should install `@stacklatte/chart-react`. Other platforms: React Native → `@stacklatte/chart-native`, Angular → `@stacklatte/chart-angular`.

Existing imports keep working:

```tsx
import { SLChart, calcEMA } from '@stacklatte/chart-web';
```

Migration is a find-and-replace of the import path; the exports are identical. See https://github.com/Asterix19/charts/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-chart-core.md and https://github.com/Asterix19/charts/blob/main/llms-full.txt
